facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a parent whose child is starting to explore cupboards. Help them consider the kit as part of preparing their home. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research. Do not imply any lock fits every cupboard or that the kit replaces supervision.

variants.concept: Prepare the cupboard your child is exploring
variants.primary_text: When little hands start reaching for the snack cupboard, it can become part of your child’s everyday exploring. The Peach Bucket kit includes cabinet/fridge locks to help you prepare those spots at home. Check the product details to see whether the locks suit your cupboards. They’re one part of childproofing, alongside adult supervision.
variants.headline: Cabinet and fridge locks for home prep

variants.primary_text: If you’re looking at the cereal cupboard and wondering where to begin, The Peach Bucket kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support. It gives you a way to get guidance as you prepare your cupboards, rather than guessing at the installation. Check the product details to see whether the locks suit your cupboards. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 installation video support

variants.concept: Consider other areas of the home, too
variants.primary_text: As your child explores the cupboard, you may also be thinking about other spots at home. The Peach Bucket six-part kit includes cabinet/fridge locks, socket guards and edge/corner protectors. That gives you options to consider beyond cupboards as you prepare your home. Check product details for suitability, and remember adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: A six-part kit for home childproofing

internal_notes: The cupboard-exploring scenario is hypothetical, not a customer research finding.
Copy does not claim that the locks fit every cupboard. Shoppers are directed to product details to check suitability.
Adult supervision is included as a necessary qualification. No safety outcome is promised.
Offer and guarantee claims are omitted because policy eligibility details were not supplied.
